definition: to go through something as it happens
description: On a wet mossy rock in front of a tall waterfall in a green mountain valley, a young woman in a black swimsuit stands barefoot with her arms spread wide, head tilted back and mouth open in a shout of joy as the spray soaks her hair and skin. For a moment she puts a hand over her face and laughs, then spreads her arms again. The white column of water pours down behind her, and steep forested slopes lie on both sides under a pale sky.
